proof: Per target hour, every fixed nonnegative-weight band support is a weighted mean of cell valid/effective support with a common denominator, and cannot exceed the maximum single-cell support. Allowing a different maximizing cell per horizon and anchor is deliberately more permissive than any fixed band.
method: Same hourly anchors as original target-only bound; each of three four-quarter intervals at offsets 0,8,20 must have some 38 kHz cell with >=80% support. Count TRAIN anchor dates and add all 67 non-TRAIN calendar days. An upper bound below90 excludes every fixed band on the existing64x2m grid under unchanged QC.
conditions: Completed exact census-v2, original target-only report and independently accepted full support-map JSON first
Counts/dates only; no winning cells, rankings, bands, score optimization or maxima-based band proposal
No held-out acoustic access, zero benchmarks, no corpus promotion or R1/R2 approval
limits: Only original38kHz and existing64x2m grid under unchangedQC/support/day gates
Does not rule out a frequency/QC/support change or separately reviewed new protocol
An upper bound>=90 establishes no eligible fixed band
